cases.evidence_condition: Exact 5.1.1 synthetic profile; independent parent receipt and all selected task artifacts are hash-bound; every local gate passes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the synthetic report and obtain external real-artifact evidence before any promotion review.

cases.evidence_condition: Provider version or environment profile differs from the only pinned profile.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create and forward-validate a separate exact-version profile.

cases.evidence_condition: Declared parent SHA-256 differs from the bytes read by the auditor.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore the immutable record or issue a reviewed lineage replacement.

cases.evidence_condition: Parent gates self-report pass but no independently hash-bound validation receipt matches the current parent bytes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Produce an independent validation receipt bound to gate evidence hashes.

cases.evidence_condition: Structure, k-point, potential-metadata, settings, protocol, or wavefunction identity differs across parent, declaration, and execution.
cases.minimum_next_action: Regenerate one atomic handoff from the exact DFT parent and execution records.

cases.evidence_condition: A fatal marker is present or the exact-profile completion marker is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve the failed run, diagnose it, and provide a new complete artifact.

cases.evidence_condition: Absolute charge or total spilling is absent, invalid, or exceeds the predeclared threshold.
cases.minimum_next_action: Reassess parent quality and basis choice without post-hoc threshold relaxation.

cases.evidence_condition: Projected-band fraction, projection energy window, or projection Fermi evidence is incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Supply projection-population and reference-window evidence before curve analysis.

cases.evidence_condition: Curve sign, integral semantics, Fermi reference, or energy window is absent or detached from lobsterout evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Re-export the curve with explicit unshifted convention and matching projection reference.

cases.evidence_condition: The request asks automation to conclude bond existence, order, strength, oxidation state, stability, or causality.
cases.minimum_next_action: Limit automation to technical evidence and obtain an independent expert decision.
